title: malcolmia triloba subsp. broussonetii
intro: Malcolmia triloba subsp. broussonetii, commonly known as Rock Whitlow-grass, is a plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It is traditionally used to treat various health issues, including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which provide health benefits such as wound healing and soothing skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Rock Whitlow-grass include its ability to inhibit microbial growth, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
